integration_issues.issue: Spec says 'debounced search updates the URL params (300ms)' but the actual implementation at CardsServicePage.js:43-71 has NO debounce and NO setSearchParams — salesSearch is a useState that only triggers a reload when the user clicks the refresh-sales-btn or via loadSales(salesPage, salesSearch) effect. Pagination + server-side filter shape works correctly; the UX promise of as-you-type debounced refetch + URL persistence is not yet implemented.

action_items: Optional: implement the debounced-search + URL-param sync in CardsServicePage.js as described in the iter-16 spec. The backend already supports ?search= server-side; only the React wiring (useDebouncedValue + setSearchParams + reload effect) is missing.
Optional cleanup: remove the 2 unused eslint-disable directives at /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/SaasAdminPage.js:240 and :252 left over from the dead-code excision.

Optional: legacy SaasAdminPage.js still carries orphaned state setters (e.g., openTenantDialog, settleDebtDialogOpen) referenced by no JSX — main agent noted they are kept intentionally. Recommend a follow-up sweep to remove them once stable for one more iter.
critical_code_review_comments: supplier_routes.py:553 — regex search escape is hand-rolled (`''.join('\\'+c if c in r'.^$*+?()[]{}|' else c)`). Prefer `re.escape(search)` for correctness + readability; the current list misses `\\` itself which can be exploited to inject regex tokens. Low severity but defensible defense-in-depth.

tenant_debts_routes.py:73 — the cached payload is mutated in-place (payload['cached']=True + payload['served_at']=...) on every read. If a future caller relied on the payload being immutable, this could surprise. Fine as-is since we deserialize fresh from JSON every read.

CardsServicePage.js:65-98 — `loadSales` is wrapped in useCallback with empty deps and an eslint-disable. This is intentional to prevent re-creation, but reading salesPage/salesSearch via default args means callers must always pass them explicitly (which they do). Slightly fragile pattern; a useRef of latest values is more idiomatic.

monitoring_routes.py / tenant_debts_routes.py — both modules duplicate the cache key/TTL boilerplate. Consider a `@cached_json(key=..., ttl=...)` decorator in utils/cache.py so future endpoints don't redo the JSON ser/deser + cached/served_at stamping by hand.

Frontend Cards Sales pagination footer is reachable only when total>50. The TEST tenant dataset is empty, so this code path is not exercised by automated UI. Recommend seeding ~60 sales via /platform-cards/sell against a TEST tenant in a one-time setup script so future regressions catch the prev/next button wiring.
